note: Handwritten seed merged by scripts/gen_gallery.ps1. Every entry points at a shipped, build-verified template or example. zan_example returns the referenced file(s) verbatim so agents copy a known-good starting point instead of guessing API usage.

models.gui-designer: Recommended for windows/forms. A .zform JSON document defines the window; a paired partial-class code-behind (src/App.zan, `static void OnLoad(Form form)`) holds logic. zanc projects the designed controls into typed fields (OkButton, TitleLabel, ...) at compile time - there is NO generated file to edit and NO manual main loop. Bind events with control.OnClick(...) / OnChange(...).
models.gui-immediate: Lower-level. Drive the frame loop yourself: App.CreateDark(title,w,h); app.Show(); while(app.isRunning){ if(!app.ProcessEvent())break; if(!app.needsRedraw)continue; app.BeginFrame(); app.RenderChrome(title); /* widget.Render(app,x,y,w) */ app.PresentFrame(); }. Use for custom-drawn/canvas apps and dashboards. Controls render themselves; the caller only positions/configures them.
models.game: SDL3 owns window/render/input/timing; Game.* owns domain concepts. Game.Foundation = fixed-step loop, deterministic RNG, semantic input, scenes. Game.Board = grids/turns/validated commands (gomoku, weiqi, xiangqi). Game.Cards = catalogs/zones/deck runtime (ddz). Game.Arcade2D = geometry/collision/animation/pooled entities (snake, breakout). Game.Rts = clean-room RA2-compatible engine (ra2).

entries.build: designer project: build the src/ folder entry src/App.zan with its App.zform present

entries.summary: Form with input/checkbox/select/slider/button and the full per-control event bundle (OnFocus/OnBlur/OnEnter/OnLeave/OnChange).

Declarative typed data grid: a DataGrid field with "of" (row entity type) and "columns" compiles to the generic DataGrid<T> column API (Col/NumCol/RealCol/BoolCol/DateCol); code-behind binds the caller's own List<T> via grid.Bind(list) - no DataRow, no string rows. "props" reach grid state, "rowFactory": true projects RowFactory(() => new T()).
